correctness.rationale: All finite six maxima are proved by explicit exhaustive finite certificates, not an extrapolation. Inspected actual frozen certificates.json and verify.py and independently implemented the eligibility and compatibility predicates in JavaScript: n=4,6,8,10,12,14 yield 2,6,10,24,52,128 eligible unbordered words; for each case every same-color pair in the upper partition is incompatible and every witness pair compatible. At length14 verified all 335 same-color upper pairs and all 276 witness pairs, with 24 distinct eligible witnesses. Therefore M=(1,2,3,5,11,24). The restricted Dyck Construction 7 counts (1,2,3,5,11,20) are separate published construction sizes, not upper bounds. No claim beyond n14.
